earlier_endings_checked: No express revocation, supersession or own-terms end found in the held working texts searched (Cruden number search for EO:6613; targeted pattern grep of held pinakes/wikisource/hathi-gpo texts for the others).
rationale: One-time appointment of a three-member board to study and recommend on wireless telegraphy for the Philippines. EO 1303 (1911-02-18) amends it by swapping a member, showing the board still existed then, but nothing held shows performance, report or dissolution. A one-time command's end needs evidence of performance or a revoking act; none held. Not a yes either: no current predicate. Original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: Whether and when the board reported or was discharged; Wikisource names an unnumbered order of 1911-09-04 appointing a secondary board of review, which is not held.

sources.quote: are hereby appointed a board to study and make recommendations
The report of the board will be forwarded to the Secretary of War
Executive Order No. 1198, dated April 30, 1910, is so far amended
